PackEntry.description: One pack of a board. `dev` is a pack run from a folder (`dev:`), which is badged everywhere (0.7).

PackFileChange.description: One file that differs between two pins of a pack: the manifest, a hook, a script.

lines.description: The changed lines of a text file: `@@`, `-` and `+` lines, no context.

note.description: Why there are no lines, when there are none to show.

PackFileChangeKind.description: How a file of the pack differs between two pins.

oneOf.description: A file that became a folder, a link or a submodule, or the other way round.

PackOrigin.description: Where a pack comes from (0.7, Repo packs and user packs).

oneOf.description: Compiled into the bundle, so it needs no trust prompt (0.4).
Listed in the board's `board.yaml`, shared with the team.
Added with `collide pack add`, switched on per board.

PackPin.description: What a `git:` source resolved to: the commit, and the tree at the pack's path in it (0.7, Pack sources).

description:
`config.pack_update` result. `old` is the pin now; `new` is the pin the ref resolves to. With `needs_host` set the
fetch has not run (the first fetch from that host needs the person's yes), `new` is absent and nothing was written.
`written` is true when `confirm` was set and the lock changed, in the file `lock_file` names.

changes.description: The files that differ, in path order.

note.description: What cannot be shown of the difference (the old version is no longer in the mirror).

title: ConfigPackUpdateResult
